summary: Program catalogue built declaratively (DES-02): Program__c (Public Read/Write internal OWD, Private external) with Program_Code__c (Text(20), required, unique, case-insensitive, External Id), restricted Study_Level__c and Faculty__c picklists, Active__c (default true); Active_Programs and All list views; layouts; Programs tab in the Recruitment app; Persona_Recruitment_Officer grants Program Read/Create/Edit (no Delete), FLS and tab visibility. ADR 0002 records the decision. Rebased onto integration after #20: the permission set keeps every grant from both sides. Program__c is registered in config/test-data.json by its E2E- codes for the pipeline clean-up (PIPE-15, arch-1). All 24 repo Apex tests and 10 Playwright tests pass together in the agent sandbox.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerCreateProgramWithAllFields, shouldOfferExactlyTheThreeStudyLevelsAsRestrictedPicklist, shouldOfferExactlyTheFiveFacultiesAsRestrictedPicklist, shouldDefaultNewProgramsToActive, shouldCreate200ProgramsInOneTransaction; Playwright '#4 AC1: Recruitment Officer creates a Program with code, study level, faculty and active'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldMakeProgramCodeAUniqueRequiredExternalId, shouldRejectDuplicateProgramCode, shouldRejectDuplicateProgramCodeInDifferentCase, shouldRequireProgramCode; Playwright '#4 AC2: saving a duplicate Program Code shows a duplicate-value error'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerEditAProgramCreatedBySomeoneElse, shouldGrantProgramAccessThroughPermissionSetNotProfile, shouldRefuseProgramDeleteToRecruitmentOfficer, shouldRefuseProgramCreationToMinimumAccessPersona, shouldRefuseProgramReadToMinimumAccessPersona; Playwright '#4 AC3: Recruitment Officer edits a Program's study level and active flag', '#4 AC3: Recruitment Officer cannot delete a Program (denial, TST-03)'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldShipActiveProgramsListViewVisibleToRecruitmentOfficer, shouldShowProgramsTabInRecruitmentApp; Playwright '#4 AC4: Programs tab opens from the Recruitment app and the Active Programs list shows only active programs'

testChanges.change: Setup data and the system-side read-back use SYSTEM_MODE explicitly (APX-22): Apex in this org runs in user mode by default and the test runner holds no FLS on Program fields.
testChanges.whyNotWeaker: Only setup and verification run in system mode; every persona action still runs in user mode, so CRUD/FLS is still exercised.

testChanges.change: Field and object describes are read inside System.runAs, with SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFERRED (QG-03).
testChanges.whyNotWeaker: Outside runAs the describes reported the admin's access; inside they report the persona's, which is what the test claims. Assertions are unchanged.

testChanges.change: Each catches only the exception user mode throws (TypeException 'DELETE not allowed on Program__c'; SecurityException 'Access to entity Program__c denied') and asserts its message (tests-3).
testChanges.whyNotWeaker: Stricter: before, any DmlException, SecurityException or NoAccessException passed as a refusal; now a failure for another reason fails the test. Exceptions recorded in .agent/4/diagnostics/repair-3-denial-exceptions.txt.

testChanges.change: Checks, as the persona, that AppDefinition Recruitment is visible and its AppTabMember includes Program__c, instead of Schema.describeTabs(), which lists Classic apps only.
testChanges.whyNotWeaker: describeTabs could not see a Lightning app at all; the new query proves the tab is in the app the persona opens, plus the permission set tab setting.

testChanges.test: #4 AC2: saving a duplicate Program Code shows a duplicate-value error
testChanges.change: One locator asserts the whole message 'duplicate value found: Program Code duplicates value' instead of two separate getByText checks (tests-1).
testChanges.whyNotWeaker: Stricter: the old field-name check also matched the form's own Program Code label and could not fail.

testChanges.test: #4 AC4: Programs tab opens from the Recruitment app and the Active Programs list shows only active programs
testChanges.change: Renamed from 'Programs tab opens the Active Programs list showing only active programs' to what it proves (tests-2); repair 2 made it load every list row before asserting.
testChanges.whyNotWeaker: Steps and assertions unchanged by the rename; loading every row makes the inactive Program's absence a check against the whole list.

testChanges.change: Record URL accepts /lightning/r/<id>/view; picklist selection retries then verifies the value; view-mode Active is read from its Details field as True/False.
testChanges.whyNotWeaker: Each change verifies the end state (chosen value, saved field) rather than a UI detail that differs between Lightning renderings.

openQuestions.question: RET-01 (arch-2): a follow-up issue for the Program__c Data_Retention_Policy__mdt row (Retain Indefinitely, ADR 0002 / #4) should be opened and cited in ADR 0002's Lifecycle bullet. The repair agent cannot open issues.

findings.note: #40 put the pipeline-owned clean-up on integration. Program__c is registered in config/test-data.json (Program_Code__c LIKE 'E2E-%'), so it is removed after every QA and sandbox run; the persona still has no Delete (AC3, SHR-08). Spec comment updated.
The deferral stands (accepted in plan and ADR 0002). Opening a follow-up issue is outside the repair agent's tools; recorded as an open question for a person.
Handover rewritten as version 2 without scratchOrg and attempts, and validated with agent-records.mjs.
ADR 0002 Access bullet now says no sharing recalculation is needed (new object, no rows or share rows) and a later move to Private needs its own ADR.
E2E Programs are now removed by the pipeline clean-up (config/test-data.json, #40); Delete not granted to the persona.
AC2 asserts the whole duplicate message in one locator, so the form label no longer satisfies it.
AC4 renamed to '#4 AC4: Programs tab opens from the Recruitment app and the Active Programs list shows only active programs'.
Denial tests catch only the observed exception type and assert its message; read denial tightened the same way.
Handover is version 2 with structured testChanges, owned openQuestions and findings; validated.

next: reviewers; a person opens the RET-01 follow-up issue (arch-2)
